item.title: Version 2.1.3
item.description:
- New proxies can pick their own IP address: the app finds a free address next to the ATEM's and adds it to the Mac with one password prompt.
- Proxy addresses added by 2.1.2 and earlier had a wrong netmask and could be unreachable. They are now repaired automatically and the affected proxies restart.
- ATEM Software Control no longer reconnects every few seconds through the proxy.
- Cuedrift now works through the proxy.
- Bonjour advertises the proxy under its own name.
